answer: Social Matters >> Food & Drinks Question ID: 10723 Country: India Title: Using yeast cells for making curd is Halal or haram? Yeast cells are a type of Fungi. Question: Using yeast cells for making curd is Halal or haram? Yeast cells are a type of Fungi. Answer ID: 10723 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 273/197=L/1430) If yeast cell does not contain any unlawful ingredient, then it can be used to make curd. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
